data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word "baza" meaning 'powerful' or 'brave'. This name holds significant importance in Islamic history and culture, symbolizing strength and courage. The name Baz carries the meaning “Powerful, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baz usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name has historical ties to hunting and sports, reflecting both physical and mental swiftness.
